note: What a server sends to make a shop element blink once, as a tutorial does. The header carries zero.

fields.name: element
fields.note: A shop element blinks once, where the shop window is open. Element 0 is the buy button, 1 the sell button, 2 the shop item number names, 3 the item second names within the category number names, and 4 the recommended item number names. A client ignores any value above 4.

fields.name: second
fields.note: For the shop's element 3, which item within the category; a client reads nothing here otherwise.
